heroVideoLegacy._role: Background b-roll montage behind the homepage hero on the live site (Brizy brz-bg-video: autoplay, muted, loop, playsinline).
_problems: moov atom is at the END of the file (byte 127,509,495, after a 121.6 MB mdat). Without faststart a browser must fetch nearly the whole 127 MB before it can start playing - this is why the hero video often never appears.
7.3 Mbps is roughly 6x the bitrate a muted 720p background loop needs.
Carries an AAC audio track that is never heard - it is a muted background video.
.mov/QuickTime is not a reliable web delivery container; MP4 and WebM are.

_fix.remuxOnly: ffmpeg -i RUQ-broll-Montage-720.mov -c copy -an -movflags +faststart hero.mp4   # instant, no quality loss, fixes faststart + drops audio
_fix.reencode: ffmpeg -i RUQ-broll-Montage-720.mov -an -c:v libx264 -crf 28 -preset slow -vf scale=1280:-2 -movflags +faststart hero.mp4
_fix.expected: ~15-20 MB, playable within the first second

heroVideoLegacy._status: Superseded by assets.heroVideo. Kept for provenance.

heroVideo._encode: ffmpeg -i in.mov -an -c:v libx264 -crf 30 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -g 60 -movflags +faststart out.mp4
heroVideo._vs_original: 127.6 MB -> 11.0 MB (11.6x smaller); moov moved to the front so playback starts immediately.
